ruleDefinitions.name: Successful Overpass the Hash Attempt
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects successful logon with logon type 9 (NewCredentials) which matches the Overpass the Hash behavior of e.g Mimikatz's sekurlsa::pth module. Note: Unmapped fields: LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4624 AND LogonType = 9 AND LogonProcessName = "seclogo" AND AuthenticationPackageName = "Negotiate")
